data.name: Blood Moon Serenade: Complete Edition
data.detailed_description:
Blood Moon Serenade Complete Edition is a story-driven otome visual novel originally released for mobile and now brought to PC.

Read through a dark romance set within the secretive world of vampire aristocracy, make choices at key moments, and decide the path your heroine will follow. Will you seek true love in the light, or surrender to forbidden desires and take your place in the underworld?

This Complete Edition includes all three Blood Moon Serenade titles in one buy-to-play release, allowing you to experience the full series together on Steam.

Features

* A dark fantasy romance story centered on vampire nobility

* Classic otome visual novel gameplay: read the story, make choices, and shape the heroine’s fate

* Three Blood Moon Serenade titles included in one Complete Edition

* A buy-to-play PC release based on the mobile version

Synopsis

Your peaceful life unravels with the sudden disappearance of your father and the spread of a strange and deadly plague. While desperately searching for a cure, you are kidnapped by a mysterious vampire lord who drags you into the world of eternal night. Enchanted by Gothic castles, secret passageways, and untold luxury, you find yourself slowly slipping into the darkness.

Will you choose to fight the scourge and seek love in the light, or succumb to forbidden desires and claim your place in the underworld? Make your choice in this sweeping two-season romance filled with secrets, aristocratic intrigue, and dark passions.

Characters

Cassius – The Town Doctor

"You trust too easily, girl. You don’t realize how dangerous I really am."

A brilliant but cold physician, Cassius is always in control—but his lack of empathy and cynical outlook keep others at arm’s length. He avoids personal connections and hides a past riddled with guilt. Can you show him that even someone burdened by sin is still worthy of love?

Raoul – The Devout Priest

"It only takes a spark of light to chase away the shadows. A little faith can go a long way."

Your childhood friend and a well-loved priest, Raoul is gentle, loyal, and steadfast in his faith. He strives to do what’s right, no matter the cost. But as his world begins to fall apart, will your bond be strong enough to hold him together?

Virgil – The Enigmatic Puppeteer

"I’d much rather toy with you than answer difficult questions. You’re just so delightful to play with."

The eccentric puppeteer who speaks in riddles and sees the world as a stage. Virgil reigns over a motley family of orphans and outcasts—but beneath the whimsy lies a shadowy truth. Can you look past the performance and find the man behind the mask?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual-core processor or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 display or higher recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz dual-core processor or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080 display recommended.
